clue.text: Hit triads dumping eastern heroin

indicators.note: dumping says a letter is thrown out of the word for triads

parts.note: triads are groups of three, or threes
H is slang for heroin

explanation.surface: Chinese gangsters giving up drug dealing in the East are hit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dumping' removes one E from THREES, leaving THRES; H for heroin goes on the end.
explanation.definitionFit: To thresh is to beat grain, so it is a synonym for hit or strike repeatedly.

clue.text: Embracing Aristotle's conclusion, author turned philosopher

indicators.note: embracing means holding something within, so one piece goes inside the other
turned signals the letters of author are rearranged
the conclusion of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A writer who took up Aristotle's final ideas and became a philosopher.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned' rearranges AUTHOR to THORAU, which 'Embracing' wraps round E, the last letter of Aristotle's.
explanation.definitionFit: Henry David Thoreau, author of Walden, was an American transcendentalist thinker.

clue.text: Betray in no way a king ascendant

indicators.note: ascendant means rising, so in a down light the pieces read upwards

parts.note: in no way means not
R is the abbreviation for king, from Latin rex

explanation.surface: A king rising to power by treachery seems to betray nobody.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ascendant' turns NOTAR upward to give the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: To rat on someone is an informal idiom for informing against or betraying them.

clue.text: Southern pop singer needs backing of Australian movement

parts.note: Cher is the American pop singer

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the letters for Australian are reversed

parts.note: Oz is the informal name for Australia, so Australian gives OZ

explanation.surface: A singer from the South needs Australian support for a political movement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing of' turns OZ into ZO.
explanation.definitionFit: A scherzo is a lively section of a symphony or sonata, one musical movement among several.

clue.text: One large display of snowdrops without roots?

parts.note: a means one
a drift is a large mass of flowers, as in a drift of snowdrops under trees

explanation.surface: A mass of snowdrops that has come loose from the soil.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks a playful definition: something with no roots is cast loose and drifting.
explanation.definitionFit: Being unanchored and aimless is like a plant pulled from the earth, a figurative sense.

clue.text: Delegate gets stuck into British comic

indicators.note: into says the word for stuck sits inside the comic's name

parts.note: Jack Dee is a deadpan British stand-up comedian
stuck as in 'stick it there' means placed, or put

explanation.surface: A conference delegate gets stuck into a British comic book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' signals the container. 'comic' looks like a magazine such as the Beano, but it is a comedian.
explanation.definitionFit: To depute is to appoint someone to act for you or hand over a task, a synonym of delegate.

clue.text: Monkey transformed to rear commander

parts.note: monkey, as in a mischievous child, means imp

indicators.note: transformed says the letters of to rear take a new shape

explanation.surface: A monkey changed into a rear-guard commander.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transformed' rearranges TOREAR to ERATOR.
explanation.definitionFit: Imperator was the Latin title for a victorious Roman general, later an emperor.

clue.text: Shamelessly go to bed with Hook — a basis for many an oath

definitions.text: a basis for many an oath

indicators.note: shamelessly suggests wanton behaviour, so the letters of the phrase are thrown about

explanation.surface: An invitation to sleep brazenly with Captain Hook.
explanation.walkthrough: Witnesses traditionally swear on the Bible, which this phrase names.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bible is the holy text sworn upon in court, so it underlies many sworn promises.

clue.text: Not at all susceptible to gibes like 16 across, if absorbing

definitions.text: Not at all susceptible to gibes
definitions.meaning: taken literally, impossible to insult, since a put-down is a gibe
said of a gripping volume, one so engrossing you cannot stop reading

explanation.surface: A book that cannot be mocked and keeps you hooked.
explanation.walkthrough: The first reading splits the word into un-, put-down and -able.
explanation.definitionFit: Both readings hold: a compelling read in the everyday sense, and immune to insults in the literal one.

clue.text: See 25
Worker wants small animal with temper as a variety act prop

parts.note: a hand is a manual worker, as in farmhand
a pup is a young dog
a pet is a fit of sulking or bad temper

explanation.surface: A labourer wants a little creature with attitude to use in a stage act.
explanation.definitionFit: A glove-shaped figure worked by the hand is a stock prop of ventriloquists and variety shows.

clue.text: Performer sounded low note

indicators.note: sounded says the singer's word is said out loud to give a different spelling

parts.note: a tenor is a singer, a performer

explanation.surface: A singer produced a deep note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'low note' looks musical but means a banknote of small value. A tenner is British slang for a ten-pound note.
explanation.definitionFit: A ten-pound note is one of the lowest-value British banknotes, hence a low note.

clue.text: Defaulter, I organised housing beyond a certain point

indicators.note: housing means holding inside, so the answer lies within the run of letters

explanation.surface: Someone who defaulted on a debt arranged for housing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organised' looks like an anagram signal but is only part of the letters held.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin sense of the word is 'further', lying outside or past a boundary.

clue.text: Pseudo-technical jargon: "Drone verbal contention"

parts.note: to drone is to make a low humming, a buzz
to have words is to argue

explanation.surface: A dictionary entry quoting 'drone' and 'verbal contention' as jargon terms.
explanation.definitionFit: Trendy terms used to sound impressive in business or tech are fashionable jargon.

clue.text: Tissue transplant operation — developed lazy stoop

indicators.note: developed says the letters of lazy stoop are reworked into something new

explanation.surface: A patient developed a lazy stoop after a transplant operation.
explanation.definitionFit: This surgical term names grafting tissue from an animal onto a human.

clue.text: Which calls for show of hands from boss, Rod

definitions.text: Which calls for show of hands

parts.note: a boss is a raised knob, or stud
a poker is a metal rod for a fire

explanation.surface: A vote by raised hands called for by the boss, Rod.
explanation.walkthrough: 'show of hands' looks like voting; in this card game players show their hands.
explanation.definitionFit: In this card game some cards are dealt face up, and players finally reveal what they hold.

clue.text: See 7
Lout pulled up headgear for time of his life

indicators.note: pulled up in a down light means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: yob is British slang for a lout
a hood is a covering for the head

explanation.surface: A hooligan tugs up his hood and has the time of his life.
explanation.definitionFit: A boy's youth is the period of his life before manhood.

clue.text: In respectful dread of one-way furrow

parts.note: a means one
west is a direction, a way to go
a ruck is a crease or wrinkle, a furrow

explanation.surface: Wondering at a single-direction furrow in a field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one-way' looks like one word, but splits into one and way.
explanation.definitionFit: Being filled with wonder mixed with fear or reverence is the sense.

clue.text: Cy sleeps soundly, which allows a nervy connection

indicators.note: soundly, beyond meaning deeply asleep, says the words are spoken

parts.note: Cy is a man's name, short for Cyrus; sleeps means naps, dozes

explanation.surface: A man named Cy sleeps deeply, letting his nerves link up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soundly' seems to describe the sleep, but signals the homophone.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the junction between nerve cells where signals pass, so it is literally a nerve link.

clue.text: Present distributor's access point?

parts.note: Father Christmas, who hands out gifts, traditionally enters homes down the flue

explanation.surface: Where a gift-giver gets into the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Present distributor' sounds like a business but is Santa Claus.
explanation.definitionFit: Santa Claus is said to come down the flue to deliver gifts, making it his way in.

clue.text: Not what it once was, iconic bear without a spread

parts.note: ex means former, no longer what it was

indicators.note: without says a letter is dropped from the bear

parts.note: the panda is an iconic bear, symbol of the WWF

explanation.surface: A famous bear, now past it, has lost its spread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without a' drops the final A from PANDA.
explanation.definitionFit: To spread out or grow larger is a synonym.

clue.text: Ground delays besetting team — Reading awkward with this

indicators.note: besetting means surrounding, so the team sits inside the mixed letters
ground, as in broken down, says the letters of delays are mixed

parts.note: XI is eleven in Roman numerals, a cricket or football team

explanation.surface: Ground delays hold up a team visiting Reading, the English town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ground' rearranges the letters to DYSLEA and 'besetting' wraps them round the team. Reading looks like the Berkshire town but is the act of reading.
explanation.definitionFit: This learning difficulty makes reading and spelling hard, so reading is awkward for those who have it.

clue.text: Down with family consumer protection!

parts.note: down is soft fluff, and nap is the soft raised surface of cloth
kin means family

explanation.surface: A protest slogan: away with relatives, up with consumer rights!
explanation.walkthrough: 'consumer' is one who eats, not a shopper.
explanation.definitionFit: A cloth laid on the lap shields a diner's clothes from spills, protecting the eater.

clue.text: See 15
Junk's fish concession round barrier

parts.note: cod is a fish

indicators.note: round says the concession wraps about the barrier

parts.note: a sop is something given to placate, a concession
a wall is a barrier

explanation.surface: A Chinese junk's fishing rights come with a sea wall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Junk' looks like a boat but means rubbish talk.
explanation.definitionFit: This British slang word means nonsense, much as junk means worthless stuff.

clue.text: Part of truss delivered by Royal Mail

definitions.meaning: a vertical central beam in a roof frame
mail sent by the monarch's postal service is, in jest

explanation.surface: Part of a roof frame arrives in the post.
explanation.walkthrough: Royal Mail is the UK's postal service, historically the crown's.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the upright beam in a roof frame, and read as two words it is the monarch's mail.

clue.text: Pop's spiked with most of whiskey spirits

indicators.note: a drink spiked with something has it added inside

parts.note: pop is a father, so pops are dads

indicators.note: most of drops the last letter of the word for whiskey

parts.note: rye is a kind of whiskey

explanation.surface: Father's drink has been laced with whiskey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' drops the last letter; 'spiked with' puts what is left inside. 'spirits' looks like drinks but means wood nymphs.
explanation.definitionFit: These are tree nymphs of Greek myth, nature spirits.

clue.text: Reverse the unravelling and settle?

parts.note: de- is a prefix that undoes or reverses, as in defrost
to fray is to unravel at the edges

explanation.surface: A plea to undo the fraying and calm things down.
explanation.definitionFit: To pay costs is to settle a bill, the financial sense.
